rule.statement: The interview panel should consider other supporting documents submitted by the petitioners and grant marks for them, even if they do not have documentary proof to prove the ownership of their residence.
rule.supporting_quote: However, I am of the opinion that, the interview panel should have considered the other documents submitted by the petitioners and granted marks for the said supporting documents in terms of Clause 6.1 of Circular No. 22 of 2017, even though the petitioners did not have documentary proof to prove the ownership of their residence.
